sources.articleTitle: Anwar, Wan Azizah convey condolences over Melaka PKR leader J. Samivel’s passing

headline: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim Expresses Condolences On Death Of Leader
seoTitle: Anwar Ibrahim Mourns Passing Of PKR Official
metaDescription: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and his wife offered condolences following the death of Melaka PKR leader J. Samivel, as reported by local media outlets.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and Wan Azizah Wan Ismail offered condolences for the passing of J. Samivel.
J. Samivel served as a leader within the PKR party based in the Melaka region.
The official acknowledgment of the passing was reported by Malay Mail on November 11, 2026.
aiContextParagraph: The Prime Minister of Malaysia, Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, along with his wife, Datuk Seri Dr Wan Azizah Wan Ismail, publicly acknowledged the passing of J. Samivel, a member of the Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR) in Melaka. The communication served as a formal expression of sympathy for the loss of a local political figure. J. Samivel was recognized for his involvement in PKR, which is a major component of the current government coalition. Public records and local reporting indicate the news emerged on November 11, 2026, drawing attention from individuals seeking updates on political figures and party personnel. While the report focuses on the leadership's response, it underscores the political community's engagement during moments of mourning for long-standing organizational members. No further details regarding the circumstances of the passing or the official's history were provided in the initial coverage regarding this event.
